stock.description: KWG Living Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides residential and non-residential property management services in the People’s Republic of China. The company operates through two segments, Residential Property Management Services, and Non-Residential Property Management and Commercial Operational Services. It also offers commercial operational, real estate intermediary and real estate consultant, advertising planning, intelligent engineering, and business services, as well as urban and rural environmental sanitation services. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
